reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: default sheet=1.6 mm, supported 1.6–2.4 mm, actual grip/links/carrier extrusions
mapping.carrier: original surrounding frame with cross-bars; four low runners per released part, 12 total; source carrier-and-tab construction adapted, not raw source geometry
mapping.tabs: proposed 0.8–1.2 mm width, 0.4–0.6 mm thickness versus measured 0.21–0.22 mm source runner tops
mapping.sourceSockets: not used; no source press-fit or switch interfaces imposed
mapping.newJoints: two external M3 axles, bores=3+0.2–0.5 mm DIAMETRICAL allowance, 0.7 mm plane gap
mapping.newMechanism: serial double pendulum, upper span44–56 mm, lower reach20–28 mm, distal bob radius7–9 mm; moving links in separate parallel planes
mapping.newPersonalization: Boolean engraving only in safe grip patch centered at original X=-35,Y=0; radial keep-in6.5 mm, ≥1 mm backing
mapping.novelty: two serial independent rotary DOFs; unlike prior equal-pivot divider or invertible single rigid pendulum. Independent illustrative poses; no dynamics or chaos claim
